## 1. Data Recode/Organizations 
```{r data_recode, echo=FALSE}
# recode employ and job strain 
table(woc_og$job.strain, woc_og$employed)
table1::table1(~job.strain | employed, woc_og %>%  mutate(employed = if_else(is.na(employed) == T, "unemployed", employed)))
woc_og<- woc_og %>%  mutate(employed =  case_when(employed == 1 ~ "employed", 
                                                  employed == 0 ~ "unemployed", T ~ employed), 
                            job.strain = case_when(job.strain == 1 ~ "yes_js", 
                                                   job.strain == 0 ~ "no_js",  T ~ job.strain), 
                            
                           job.strain_employed = paste0(job.strain, "_", employed))

table(woc_og$job.strain_employed)
# neaten js_employed 
woc_og<- woc_og %>%  mutate(job.strain_employed = case_when(job.strain_employed == "NA_NA" ~ NA, 
                                                            job.strain_employed == "NA_unemployed" ~ "Unemployed", 
                                                            T ~ job.strain_employed))

DataExplorer::plot_missing(woc_og)
# if you see missingness then: 
# drop anyone with missing all stressors 
t <- woc_og%>%  filter(is.na(social.support.cat) & is.na(sle.cat) & 
                       is.na(job.strain_employed) & is.na(pss.4.cat)) 
woc_og<- woc_og %>% filter(id != t$id) # THIS may not work if woc_og has no missingness.
```


## 2. Cluster analysis 
```{r lca}
####### cluster stress: tidy lca ########
desc <- tidySEM::descriptives(woc_og %>%  dplyr::select(social.support.cat, sle.cat, job.strain_employed, pss.4.cat) %>% 
                                mutate(across(1:4, ~as.factor(.))))

desc <- desc[, c("name", "type", "n", "missing", "unique", "mode",
                 "mode_value", "v")]
desc

# Step 1. check whether we should do varying variance or not 
# Fixed variance model
model_fixed <- mx_lca(data = woc_og %>%  dplyr::select("social.support.cat","sle.cat", "job.strain_employed", "pss.4.cat") 
                           
                           %>%
                             dplyr::rename_with(~ gsub("\\.", "_", .x)) 
                           %>%  mutate(across(1:4, ~as.ordered(.))), classes = 2, variances = "equal")

# Varying variance model
model_varying <- mx_lca(data = woc_og %>%  dplyr::select("social.support.cat","sle.cat", "job.strain_employed", "pss.4.cat") 
                             
                             %>%
                               dplyr::rename_with(~ gsub("\\.", "_", .x)) 
                             %>%  mutate(across(1:4, ~as.ordered(.))), classes = 2, variances = "varying")

# Compare models
table_fit(list(Fixed = model_fixed, Varying = model_varying))

# Step 2. do LCA with tidylca 
set.seed(123)
res <- mx_lca(data = woc_og %>%  dplyr::select("social.support.cat","sle.cat", "job.strain_employed", "pss.4.cat") %>%
                dplyr::rename_with(~ gsub("\\.", "_", .x))  %>% 
                mutate(across(1:4, ~as.ordered(.))), 
              classes = 1:6, # test multiple models fits
              variances = "fixed")  # use fixed variances 

# view model fit
kableExtra::kable(print(res)) %>%  kableExtra::kable_styling()
plot_prob(res[[2]], bw = TRUE)
#plot_density(res[[2]])

# join estimated classes with woc data
class<- round(as.data.frame(class_prob(res[[2]], type = "individual")) , 2)
plot_missing(class)

# bind the class results with original data
woc_lca_tidysem<- cbind.data.frame(woc_og, class)

# check missing for important variables for modeling 
plot_missing(
  woc_lca_tidysem %>%  select(individual.predicted, # exposure 
                             mat_age, mat_educ,  bmi.procedure, gest.age.procedure, # covariates imp for modeling
                           # mat_age, mat_educ, marital, bmi.procedure, smoke, mat_race_eth, gest.age.procedure, parity,
                            bde_47_m, bde_47_m_log, bde_99_m, bde_99_m_log, bde_100_m,  bde_100_m_log, bde_153_m, bde_153_m_log, 
                            bde_47_p, bde_47_p_log, bde_99_p, bde_99_p_log, bde_100_p, bde_100_p_log, bde_153_p, bde_153_p_log, 
                            IL.6_m, IL.8_m, IL.7_m, CXCL10_m, CCL2_m, IFN.Gamma_m, CCL3_m, CCL22_m, CCL4_m, IL.4_m, CXCL9_m, IFN.Alpha_m, TNF.Alpha_m, TNF.RI_m, CCL17_m, IL.28A_p, IL.6_p, IL.8_p, CXCL10_p, IL.10_p,  CCL2_p, CCL3_p, CCL22_p, CCL4_p, IL.4_p, IL.2_p, IFN.Alpha_p, TNF.Alpha_p, TNF.RI_p, IL.12_p, IL.1Beta_p, IL.28A_c, IL.6_c, IL.8_c, IL.7_c, IL.10_c, IFN.Gamma_c, IL.4_c, IL.2_c, IFN.Alpha_c, TNF.RI_c, IL.1Beta_c, CCL17_c, CXCL9_c, CCL4_c, CCL22_c, CCL3_c, CCL2_c, CXCL10_c, IL.12_c, 
                            IL.6_m_log, IL.8_m_log, IL.7_m_log, CXCL10_m_log, CCL2_m_log, IFN.Gamma_m_log, CCL3_m_log, CCL22_m_log, CCL4_m_log, IL.4_m_log, CXCL9_m_log, IFN.Alpha_m_log, TNF.Alpha_m_log, TNF.RI_m_log, CCL17_m_log, IL.28A_p_log, IL.6_p_log, IL.8_p_log, CXCL10_p_log, IL.10_p_log,  CCL2_p_log, CCL3_p_log, CCL22_p_log, CCL4_p_log, IL.4_p_log, IL.2_p_log, IFN.Alpha_p_log, TNF.Alpha_p_log, TNF.RI_p_log, IL.12_p_log, IL.1Beta_p_log, IL.28A_c_log, IL.6_c_log, IL.8_c_log, IL.7_c_log, IL.10_c_log, IFN.Gamma_c_log, IL.4_c_log, IL.2_c_log, IFN.Alpha_c_log, TNF.RI_c_log, IL.1Beta_c_log, CCL17_c_log, CXCL9_c_log, CCL4_c_log, CCL22_c_log, CCL3_c_log, CCL2_c_log, CXCL10_c_log, IL.12_c_log)
```

```{r univar_tables}
# build function to calculate summary measures: geometric mean, geometric sd, min, med, max
dist.func <- function(x) {
  c(
    geomean = round(exp(mean(log(x), na.rm = TRUE)), 2),
    geosd = round(exp(sd(log(x), na.rm = TRUE)), 2),      
    min = round(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),                
    med = round(median(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),           
    max = round(max(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2)                 
  )
}

# BDEs - see Kaegan's code 
bde_names <- c("bde_47_m", "bde_99_m", "bde_100_m", "bde_153_m", "bde_47_p", "bde_99_p", "bde_100_p", "bde_153_p")
stress_names <- c("sle.cat", "social.support.cat", "job.strain", "employed", "pss.4.cat", "individual.predicted")

write.csv(woc_lca_tidysem %>% 
            #woc_imp_mice %>%
            dplyr::select(all_of(bde_names), all_of(stress_names)) %>%
            pivot_longer(cols = all_of(stress_names), names_to = "stress_var", values_to = "stress_group") %>%
            pivot_longer(cols = all_of(bde_names), names_to = "bde", values_to = "value") %>%
            group_by(stress_var, stress_group, bde) %>%
            summarise(
              geomean = round(exp(mean(log(value), na.rm = TRUE)), 2),
              geosd   = round(exp(sd(log(value), na.rm = TRUE)), 2)) %>%
            mutate(matrix = case_when(
              str_detect(bde, "_m$") ~ "maternal",
              str_detect(bde, "_p$") ~ "placental")) %>%
            mutate(
              #stress_group = recode(stress_group,
              #                            "1" = "low",
              #                            "2" = "high"),
              bde = recode(bde, !!!bde_label_nolog_t)) %>%
            mutate(mean_sd = paste0(geomean, " (", geosd, ")")) %>%
            dplyr::select(stress_var, stress_group, bde, matrix, mean_sd) %>%
            pivot_wider(names_from = c("stress_group", "stress_var"), values_from = mean_sd), 
          file = "Table2_tidysem.csv")

# range

            pivot_longer(cols = all_of(bde_names), names_to = "bde", values_to = "value") %>%
            group_by(stress_var, stress_group, bde) %>%
            summarise(
             # geomean = round(exp(mean(log(value), na.rm = TRUE)), 2),
             # geosd   = round(exp(sd(log(value), na.rm = TRUE)), 2), 
              max = round((max(log(value), na.rm = TRUE)), 2), 
              min = round((min(log(value), na.rm = TRUE)), 2)) %>%
            mutate(matrix = case_when(
              str_detect(bde, "_m$") ~ "maternal",
              str_detect(bde, "_p$") ~ "placental")) %>%
            mutate(
              #stress_group = recode(stress_group,
              #                            "1" = "low",
              #                            "2" = "high"),
              bde = recode(bde, !!!bde_label_nolog_t)) %>%
            mutate(max_min = paste0(min, " - ", max)) %>%
            dplyr::select(stress_var, stress_group, bde, matrix, max_min) %>%
            pivot_wider(names_from = c("stress_group", "stress_var"), values_from = max_min) %>%   select(bde, matrix, starts_with("Class")) %>% View()
```

```{r models}
# stratified models 

# interaction linear models - maternal 
reg_em_strata <- function(data, outcomes, predictors, stress, level) {
  models <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(outcomes)) {
    for (j in seq_along(predictors)) {
      model_name <- paste0(outcomes[i], " ~ ", predictors[j] , "+ mat_age + mat_educ + bmi.procedure + gest.age.procedure")
      formula <- as.formula(model_name)
      model <- lm(formula = formula, data = data)
      n <- nobs(model)
      models[[model_name]] <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(outcome = outcomes[i], n = n)
    }
  }
  return(bind_rows(models))
}
```

```{r}
## qgcomp 
mice.qgcomp.emm<- function(matrix, stressor){
  if(matrix == "maternal"){
    # Define outcomes
    outcomes <- c("IL.6_m_log", 
                  "IL.8_m_log", 
                  "IL.7_m_log", 
                  "CXCL10_m_log",
                  "CCL2_m_log", 
                  "IFN.Gamma_m_log",
                  "CCL3_m_log", 
                  "CCL22_m_log", 
                  "CCL4_m_log", 
                  "IL.4_m_log", 
                  "CXCL9_m_log", 
                  "IFN.Alpha_m_log", 
                  "TNF.Alpha_m_log", 
                  "TNF.RI_m_log", 
                  "CCL17_m_log")
    
    # Define exposure
    exposures <- c("bde_47_m_log", "bde_99_m_log","bde_100_m_log", "bde_153_m_log")
    
    all_results<- list()
    
    for (outcome in outcomes) {
      # formula 
      current_formula <- as.formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ bde_47_m_log + bde_99_m_log + bde_100_m_log + bde_153_m_log +
                                                 Class + mat_age + mat_educ + bmi.procedure + gest.age.procedure"))
      
      qg_models<- qgcomp.emm.noboot( f = current_formula,
                                       expnms = c("bde_47_m_log", "bde_99_m_log", "bde_100_m_log", "bde_153_m_log"),
                                       dat = woc_lca %>% dplyr::select(outcomes, exposures,  Class , mat_age, mat_educ, bmi.procedure, gest.age.procedure) %>%  mutate(Class = as.factor(Class)), 
                                       family = gaussian(),
                                       emmvar = "Class")
      
      all_results[[outcome]] <- qg_models
    } } 
  
  if(matrix == "placenta"){
    # Define outcomes
    # outcomes <- c("IL.2_p_log", "IL.12_p_log", "IFN.Alpha_p_log", "TNF.Alpha_p_log", "TNF.RI_p_log",
    #               "IL.1Beta_p_log", "IL.10_p_log", "IL.4_p_log", "IL.6_p_log", "IL.28A_p_log", 
    #               "IL.8_p_log", "CCL2_p_log", "CCL3_p_log", "CCL4_p_log", "CXCL10_p_log", "CCL22_p_log")
    
    outcomes <-  c("IL.28A_p_log", 
                   "IL.6_p_log", 
                   "IL.8_p_log", 
                   "CXCL10_p_log", 
                   "IL.10_p_log",  
                   "CCL2_p_log", 
                   "CCL3_p_log", 
                   "CCL22_p_log", 
                   "CCL4_p_log", 
                   "IL.4_p_log", 
                   "IL.2_p_log", 
                   #"IFN.Alpha_p_log", 
                   "TNF.Alpha_p_log", 
                   "TNF.RI_p_log")
    #"IL.12_p_log", 
    #"IL.1Beta_p_log")
    
    
    # Define exposure
    exposures <- c("bde_47_p_log", "bde_99_p_log","bde_100_p_log", "bde_153_p_log")
    
    all_results<- list()
    
    for (outcome in outcomes) {
      # formula 
      current_formula <- as.formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ bde_47_p_log + bde_99_p_log + bde_100_p_log + bde_153_p_log  + 
        Class + 
        mat_age + mat_educ + bmi.procedure + gest.age.procedure"))
      
      
      qg_models<- qgcomp.emm.noboot(
          f = current_formula,
          expnms =  c("bde_47_p_log", "bde_99_p_log","bde_100_p_log", "bde_153_p_log"),
          dat = woc_lca %>% dplyr::select(outcomes, exposures,  Class , mat_age, mat_educ, bmi.procedure, gest.age.procedure) %>% mutate(Class = as.factor(Class)), 
          family = gaussian(),
          emmvar = "Class") 
      
      all_results[[outcome]] <- qg_models
    } } 
  
    # Step 1: Extract estimates and standard errors from each model
  strat_effects1 <- lapply(all_results, function(x) getstrateffects(x, emmval = "1")) # map(all_results, ~ getstrateffects(.x, emmval = "1"))
  strat_effects0 <- lapply(all_results, function(x) getstrateffects(x, emmval = "2"))#map(all_results, ~ getstrateffects(.x, emmval = "2"))
  p <- lapply(all_results, function(x) as.data.frame(x$pval)[4,1])
  
  strat_weight1 <- lapply(all_results, function(x) getstratweights(x, emmval = "1")) # map(all_results, ~ getstratweights(.x, emmval = "1"))
  strat_weight0 <- lapply(all_results, function(x) getstratweights(x, emmval = "2"))# map(all_results, ~ getstratweights(.x, emmval = "2"))
  
  # Step 2: Combine into one data frame with imputation index
  eff_est<- 
    data.frame(
      estimate_1 = map_dbl(strat_effects1, ~ .x[["eff"]]), # psi  
      lcl_1 = map_dbl(strat_effects1, ~ .x[["ci"]][,1]), # lcl
      ucl_1 = map_dbl(strat_effects1, ~ .x[["ci"]][,2]), # ucl 
      std.error_1 = map_dbl(strat_effects1, ~ .x[["se"]]), # se 
      p_value = p,
      
      estimate_0 = map_dbl(strat_effects0, ~ .x[["eff"]]),
      lcl_0 = map_dbl(strat_effects0, ~ .x[["ci"]][,1]),
      ucl_0 = map_dbl(strat_effects0, ~ .x[["ci"]][,2]),
      std.error_0 = map_dbl(strat_effects0, ~ .x[["se"]])
    ) %>%  rownames_to_column(var = "outcome")
  
  eff_est<- eff_est%>%  mutate(outcome= str_remove(paste0("ln", outcome), "(_log)"))


  # Step 2: Combine into one data frame with imputation index
  if(matrix == "maternal"){
    strat_weight_1 <- map_dfr(seq_along(strat_weight1), function(i) {
      mod <- strat_weight1[[i]]

      # Combine positive and negative weights
      weights <- c(mod[["pos.weights"]], -mod[["neg.weights"]])

      # Convert to data frame and select components
      df <- data.frame(t(weights))
      df <- df[, c( "bde_47_m_log" ,"bde_99_m_log", "bde_100_m_log", "bde_153_m_log")]

      #  df$imp <- i  # Add imputation index
      return(df)
    })
    strat_weight_0 <- map_dfr(seq_along(strat_weight0), function(i) {
      mod <- strat_weight0[[i]]

      # Combine positive and negative weights
      weights <- c(mod[["pos.weights"]], -mod[["neg.weights"]])

      # Convert to data frame and select components
      df <- data.frame(t(weights))
      df <- df[, c( "bde_47_m_log" ,"bde_99_m_log", "bde_100_m_log", "bde_153_m_log")]

      # df$imp <- i  # Add imputation index
      return(df)
    })}

  if(matrix == "placenta"){
    strat_weight_1 <- map_dfr(seq_along(strat_weight1), function(i) {
      mod <- strat_weight1[[i]]

      # Combine positive and negative weights
      weights <- c(mod[["pos.weights"]], -mod[["neg.weights"]])

      # Convert to data frame and select components
      df <- data.frame(t(weights))
      df <- df[, c( "bde_47_p_log" ,"bde_99_p_log", "bde_100_p_log", "bde_153_p_log")]

      #  df$imp <- i  # Add imputation index
      return(df)
    })
    strat_weight_0 <- map_dfr(seq_along(strat_weight0), function(i) {
      mod <- strat_weight0[[i]]

      # Combine positive and negative weights
      weights <- c(mod[["pos.weights"]], -mod[["neg.weights"]])

      # Convert to data frame and select components
      df <- data.frame(t(weights))
      df <- df[, c( "bde_47_p_log" ,"bde_99_p_log", "bde_100_p_log", "bde_153_p_log")]

      # df$imp <- i  # Add imputation index
      return(df)
    })}

  # add model names and imp
  names <- map_dfr(strat_weight1, ~ tibble(model_name = names(.x)), .id = "outcome")
  names <- unique(names$outcome)

  # Step 3: Pool using Rubin's rules
  if(matrix == "maternal"){
    pooled_weights <- rbind.data.frame(cbind.data.frame(strat_weight_1, names) %>%  mutate(strata= 1),
                                       cbind.data.frame(strat_weight_0, names) %>%  mutate(strata= 2))

  }

  if(matrix == "placenta"){
    pooled_weights <- rbind.data.frame(cbind.data.frame(strat_weight_1, names) %>%  mutate(strata= 1),
                                       cbind.data.frame(strat_weight_0, names) %>%  mutate(strata= 2))
  }

  save(all_results, qg_models, eff_est, #pooled_results,
       strat_weight_1, strat_weight_0, pooled_weights,
       file = paste0("res_lca_cytokine_", matrix, "_", stressor, ".Rda"))
}

# run it!
mice.qgcomp.emm(matrix = "maternal", stressor = "Class")
mice.qgcomp.emm(matrix = "placenta", stressor = "Class")
```
